responsibility: Implements REAL text I/O over explicit IOChan channels. It reads numbers by skipping spaces, driving the RealConv scanner, accumulating the accepted character sequence into a DynamicString, converting it with strtod, and setting the channel’s ReadResult appropriately; for output it formats REALs through ConvStringReal helpers and writes them with StringChan field-width support, including adaptive fixed-versus-floating rendering in WriteReal.
same_name_distinction: This .mod file implements REAL text input/output over IOChan channels by consuming characters, driving the RealConv scanner, converting with strtod, and formatting output with ConvStringReal/StringChan helpers. RealIO.def only states the standard channel I/O API and formatting choices.
